# Tested preview package

[Download the v4 preview ZIP](SignalAnalysis-preview-2026-11-12-v4.zip) for the tested 12 November 2026 build, with source, preassembled programs, instructions and sample media. Unpack it into a directory named `SignalAnalysis` under your PiDP-1 installation's `FunStuff/` directory.

The archive is the original tested v4 package. The repository README and development tooling may be newer. Machine-specific core snapshots, tape assignments and runtime state are excluded.
